questions.code:
def bump(x):
    x = x + 2
    return x
def process(x):
    a = bump(x)
    x = x * 2
    if a > x:
        return a - x
    return a + x
x = 3
print(process(x), x)
questions.explanation: bump(3) returns 5; local x becomes 6; process returns 11; global x stays 3.
questions.hint: Local function parameters are not the global x.
